external_report.independent_statement_comparison: con-leche --compare (5dc36dc1) matched five target signatures against a challenge importing only Mathlib. The uncompressed challenge SHA-256 matches Deicyde CI. The full lake comparator end-to-end run was reported in progress.

local_work.checked: Original multipart digest and archive members against the first mirror commit, Git trees of both mirrors, file hashes, lockfiles, source statements, official Mathlib definitions and dated external verification logs.
local_work.local_statement_comparison: Public challenge specifications and published checker evidence inspected. No checker rerun.
local_work.reconstruction: Tracked claim by claim in the atlas and project state.
local_work.challenge_export: Downloaded and hashed compressed and expanded challenge; inspected the five exported theorem and proposition records. See targets.json.

independent_compiled_audit.walk_method: Traversal begins at each theorem, visits named constants referenced by elaborated types and values, and follows constructor, inductive and recursor links explicitly. The published results give aggregate counts by theorem and package. They do not publish the direct named edges per theorem.

module_closure.meaning: Module names recorded in compiled import headers for Main, including Lean and external packages. This does not assign proof-dependency edges between named declarations.

independent_compiled_audit.checked_locally: Downloaded the pinned outputs and checker programs. Hash-checked the decompressed module list and read the traversal, statement comparisons and build reports. The independent team's runtime produced the solution-side counts and audit outcomes.

solution_access_checked.mit_downloads: The verification page links a hash manifest for 175,187 compiled objects. It lists a hash for Main.olean; requesting the object at /~drew/grh/Main.olean returned HTTP 404.
solution_access_checked.http_probe: The extensionless /~drew/grh/solution.ndjson negotiated to solution.ndjson.zst. A 32-byte range returned application/zstd and the Zstandard frame magic. The final bytes lack the standard Zstandard seekable-format footer. No separately indexed or byte-addressable unpacked target entries were identified in the listed artifacts.
solution_access_checked.primary_mirror: The Deicyde releases API returned no releases. Its Actions artifact index listed twelve challenge-export artifacts. The CocoSgt release contains the source archive. The separate compiled audit includes aggregate declaration walks and a named module closure.
solution_access_checked.compressed_frame: The first standard Zstandard frame's header declares 61,570,595,788 decompressed bytes, exactly the length of the complete solution. Its window descriptor specifies 1 GiB. An HTTP byte range at the end of that frame cannot be decompressed independently by a standard frame decoder without earlier state.

target_terms.purpose: Hash-check the published uncompressed challenge, resolve the ten top-level names, check theorem-to-proposition type references, traverse the proposition-body expression DAGs, compare the exact lists and counts against targets.json, and confirm sorryAx occurs in each challenge proof.
target_terms.tested: The pinned independent challenge file for Lean v4.33.1; all five types passed.

solution_direct_edges.usage: From a built copy of the pinned checkout: lake env lean --run /absolute/path/to/DirectDependencies.lean Main riemannHypothesis rhOfAll
solution_direct_edges.scope: For each named theorem, definition or opaque constant, use Lean.Expr.getUsedConstants on its elaborated type and its private value. Report the direct constants in separate arrays, and the containing module. Iterating on selected output names is an explicit extra step. This extractor needs the compiled environment and has not been run on the full solution here.

tested.corpus_target: Lean v4.33.1. The pinned second audit used importModules at private visibility and Expr.getUsedConstants on that version. Exact-version end-to-end execution of this custom utility remains untested.
tested.fixture: namespace CheckDependencies / def P : Prop := True / theorem given : P := True.intro / theorem head : P := given / end CheckDependencies

compiled_object_manifest.status: The initial comparison verified the published manifest and matched every listed module path to the 175,187 original source paths. A later local inspection read seven compiled modules. Five match the MIT object digests. For the remaining two, both object hashes and the comparison of selected direct references with the published solution appear in records/compiled_edge_comparison.json.

export_size_check.check: The compressed digest matches the published manifest. The Zstandard frame declares 350862311 bytes. Independent streaming decompression produced exactly these bytes and matched the local unpacked file byte for byte and the published unpacked SHA-256. The report lists 659 more bytes for the same digest. Its cause is undetermined.

selected_solution_term_inspection.scope: Direct references of selected exported declarations. Kernel acceptance and transitive walks are separately attributed to the published reports.
